design_id: REQUIRED: coefficients belong to one concrete system design
coefficient_units: dynamic J/event above base; base W includes all installed-resource idle/static power
missing_policy: null coefficients for active events or omitted required counts block admission
notes: Fill each coefficient with [lower, upper], its evidence source and matching design/clock.
HBM path includes HBM device, controller and PHY incremental energy; base includes their idle power.
RF/SRAM and L2/NoC terms must not duplicate energy already included in compute coefficients.
DP issue counts sum over active physical DPs and include padded issues; source activity remains a proxy.
Do not insert an arbitrary residual chosen to make a preferred ratio meet the cap.
